shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find pages components styles __agent_eval__ -type f | sort && echo "--- CONFIG ---" && cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/ && echo "=== index ===" && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/index.md
for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js components/AppProvider.js; do echo "════════ $f ════════"; cat "$f"; done
for f in pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js styles/globals.css __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "════════ $f ════════"; cat "$f"; done
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls 01-app/01-getting-started/ && echo "=== GUIDES ===" && ls 01-app/02-guides/ && echo "=== APIREF ===" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls -R 01-app/03-api-reference/ | head -120

ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/ /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/ && ls -R /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md
grep -n "^#\{2,3\} " /home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/bdebf78b-58a9-4852-ab1b-6dd3d4dc0306/tool-results/bdtercpy3.txt
sed -n '281,330p;385,440p' /home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/bdebf78b-58a9-4852-ab1b-6dd3d4dc0306/tool-results/bdtercpy3.txt

wc -l /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && grep -n "^#\{2,4\} " /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/index.md
sed -n '160,300p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md

grep -rn "cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md | head -20; echo "=== SEGMENT CONFIG in caching-without ==="; grep -n "revalidate\|Route Segment Config" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -40
sed -n '302,520p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md
sed -n '572,720p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md
sed -n '752,925p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && echo "════ PAGE ════" && cat page.md && echo "════ LAYOUT (props helper) ════" && grep -n -A 40 "Layout Props Helper\|layout-props-helper" layout.md | head -80
grep -n -B5 -A 45 "Route Context Helper" route.md && echo "════ ROUTE top ════" && sed -n '1,60p' route.md
echo "════ NOT-FOUND ════" && cat not-found.md && echo "════ ERROR (head) ════" && sed -n '1,90p' error.md
grep -n -A 30 "Version History" error.md | tail -20; echo "════ global-error / reset refs ════"; grep -n "reset\|global-error\|forbidden\|unauthorized" error.md | head -40
sed -n '120,215p' error.md

sed -n '107,125p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; echo "════ FONTS getting-started ════"; sed -n '1,80p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md
grep -n "icons\|title\|description\|openGraph" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | head -50

grep -n "back()\|\.back\|push(\|forward\|refresh" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-router.md | head -25; echo "════ VERSION HIST use-router ════"; grep -n -A12 "Version History" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-router.md

sed -n '1,70p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md; echo "════ notFound ════"; sed -n '1,45p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/not-found.md
sed -n '1,120p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/incremental-static-regeneration.md

cd /workspace && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "jsonplaceholder:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 8 https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "googlefonts:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 8 "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400&display=swap") 2>&1
git rm -r --quiet pages components/AppProvider.js && echo "removed" && ls
npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -45

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/; echo "--- titles/head ---"; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|--font-inter[^;"]*\|user agent:[^<]*' | head -5; echo "--- blog ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "blog:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/blog; curl -s localhost:3123/blog/1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|og:title[^>]*>' | head -3

echo "--- blog index title ---"; curl -s localhost:3123/blog | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -2; echo "--- html tag / font ---"; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<html[^>]*>' ; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'font-inter' | head -2; echo "--- 404 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/does-not-exist; curl -s localhost:3123/does-not-exist | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|404 - Page Not Found\|Go Back Home' | head -4

echo "GET /api/posts:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts; echo "POST valid:"; curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}' -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts; echo "POST invalid:"; curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T"}' -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts; echo "PATCH (unsupported):"; curl -s -X PATCH -o /dev/null -D- localhost:3123/api/posts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "HTTP/\|allow"; echo "GET /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts/7; echo "PUT /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}' -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts/7; echo "DELETE /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -X DELETE -w " [%{http_code}]
" localhost:3123/api/posts/7
grep -n -B5 -A 35 "## Status Codes\|### Status Codes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md
rm /workspace/app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && echo removed && pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -18
pkill -f 'next.st[a]rt' ; sleep 1; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -16

echo "--- legacy API refs (should be empty) ---"; grep -rn "next/router\|next/head\|next/document\|getServerSideProps\|getStaticProps\|getStaticPaths\|getInitialProps\|isFallback\|NextApiRequest\|NextApiResponse" app components lib styles next.config.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "--- stray .js/.jsx in source ---"; find app components lib -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' | grep -v node_modules; echo "--- final tree ---"; find app components lib styles -type f | sort; echo "--- git status ---"; git status --short
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "--- pkg diff (pre-existing) ---"; git diff package.json | head -20

pkill -f 'next.st[a]rt'; sleep 1; (npx next dev -p 3125 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; for p in / /blog /blog/2 /api/posts /api/posts/3 /nope; do printf "%-16s %s\n" "$p" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3125$p)"; done; echo "--- dev errors ---"; grep -iE "error|warn|failed" /tmp/dev.log | grep -v "Attention" | head -10
pkill -f 'next.d[e]v'; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"; git status --short | grep -v "^??"
